title: htmx UI Plan
description: A structured plan of an htmx UI's response format, CSRF handling, no-JS fallback, accessibility, and swap strategy, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/htmx_progressive_enhancement_audit.mjs.

endpointResponseFormat.description: What htmx-facing endpoints return. htmx swaps bodies as HTML; JSON is the classic nothing-happens bug.

hasStateChangingRequests.description: True if the UI issues POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests via hx-* attributes.

csrfTokenIncluded.description: True if every state-changing htmx request carries the CSRF token (hx-headers, hx-vals, or htmx-aware middleware).

worksWithoutJs.description: True if forms and links function as plain HTML when JS is disabled (action= paired with hx-post, hx-boost upgrades).

dynamicRegionsAriaLive.description: True if regions updated by swaps are marked aria-live so screen readers announce changes.

focusManagedAfterSwap.description: True if focus is managed (hx-on::after-swap) when a swap replaces or removes the focused element.

clientSideStateStore.description: True if application state is being tracked in client-side JS variables alongside htmx (the anti-pattern; the server should be the source of truth).

hasTypeAheadSearch.description: True if the UI has type-as-you-search inputs firing requests on keyup.

searchDebounced.description: True if those inputs use hx-trigger with changed + delay: debouncing.

crossRegionUpdateStrategy.description: How updates outside the request target are delivered: out-of-band swaps in the same response, extra requests, or not needed.
